sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Foodstuffs Control Amendment Act 2013
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XV OF 2013
ACT XV OF 2013
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA FOODSTUFFS (CONTROL)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2013
An Act further to amend the West
Pakistan
Foodstuffs (Control) Act, 1958
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa,
Extraordinary,
20th March, 2013]
No.PA/Khyber Pakhtunkhwa/Bills/2013/7556, dated
20-3-2013.---The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Foodstuffs
(Control) (Amendment) Bill, 2013 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly
of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 8th March, 2013 and assented
to by the Governor of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 16th
March, 2013 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
Preamble.-- Whereas it is expedient further to amend the West
Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Act, 1958 (W.P. Act No. XX of 1958), for the
purpose hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Foodstuffs (Control) (Amendment) Act, 2013.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa,

20th March, 2013]
No.PA/Khyber Pakhtunkhwa/Bills/2013/7556, dated
20-3-2013.---The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Foodstuffs
(Control) (Amendment) Bill, 2013 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly
of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 8th March, 2013 and assented
to by the Governor of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 16th
March, 2013 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
Preamble.-- Whereas it is expedient further to amend the West
Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Act, 1958 (W.P. Act No. XX of 1958), for the
purpose hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
2. Amendment
of section 6 of W.P. Act No. XX of 1958.--- In the
said Act, in section 6,-
(i) in subsection (1), for the words and
commas "three years, or with fine", the words and commas "three
years, but shall not be less than seven days, or with fine which may extend to
forty-five thousand rupees, but
shall not be
less than five
thousand rupees", shall
be substituted; and
(ii) for subsection (3), the following shall be substituted,
namely:
"(3)
If any person to whom a direction is given under subsection (2) of section 3,
fails to comply with the direction, he shall be punished with imprisonment for
a term which may extend to three years, but shall not be less than seven days,
or with fine, which may extend to forty-five thousand rupees, but shall not be
less than five thousand rupees or with both.".
